reviews.title: Trying this
reviews.text:
As far as I’m seeing, I like how the app is. The only thing that stinks is it does take a long time to get to the point, but as long as you do all your hourly points up until 10 o’clock at night every day, you should be good and then you have to at least get all of your step points by midnight every night. I’m testing the app out and seeing how it goes. So for right now I’m only giving it to one, but if the app does work, then I will update. Keeping my fingers crossed for now. 

UPDATE: This app is a scam! I got higher in points and now when I do the hourly it gives me 0 points and the login daily points is 0 as well. There used to be a wheel to spin oh that’s gone for me now as well. Oh I got the 2M that the rewards say would be $200 for PayPal and when I click it I get not enough energy! This app is a big scam I was really hoping it was going to work! Shame on you!

reviews.title: CoinWalk has completely exceeded my expectations. I am genuinely very happy with this app because it
reviews.text: I’m honestly very happy with CoinWalk. This app made my daily walking more fun and motivating. It tracks my steps perfectly, the design is beautiful, and the earning system actually works. I enjoy checking my progress every day because it feels good to earn while staying active.
